manifesto.title: The ROUT manifesto
manifesto.intro: Why a QR generator needs a point of view.
manifesto.one.title: Zero tracking by default
manifesto.one.body: A QR code is a link, not a surveillance device. Static codes never phone home, and analytics only exist when you deliberately switch them on.
manifesto.two.title: Vector first
manifesto.two.body: Print is unforgiving. Every code is drawn as vector geometry so it stays razor sharp from sticker to billboard.
manifesto.three.title: Open protocols
manifesto.three.body: SEPA EPC069-12, Pix BR Code, BIP21, WPA — we implement published standards instead of proprietary redirects.
manifesto.four.title: European digital sovereignty
manifesto.four.body: Hosted in Europe, open-sourced under AGPLv3, and self-hostable. Your codes never depend on our goodwill.
